$comment: NPC pattern sets (WORK_QUEUE items 38 and 43; owner, 2026-11-13: "losing the colorful waist of the shirt patterns. I want those back, but cleaner ... I'm imagining a colorful day of the dead Mexico kind of vibes"). A set (`sets`, named; an NPC's `pattern.set` in creatures.json names one) has `places`, how many places its rings have round them (the model's band parts: the Peasant's waist ring and hat band, models.json `decor`), and `patterns`: each a `name`, an optional `weight` (default 1), `colours` the sequence round the ring (#rrggbb, 2 to `places` long, its length dividing `places`, no colour next to itself round the ring, a 3-colour pattern written as a 4-long sequence) and `pairs` (optional): per clothes part (creatures.json `colours[].part`), the bases that go with the pattern (palette ramps or #rrggbb), picked from in place of that part's own `to`. An NPC picks a pattern by weight from its variant seed (dwell-sim `npc_pattern`), then its clothes from the pattern's pairs. Prototype content (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/creatures/gen.mjs` after editing.
